verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six were licking their hands while eating. … One should not lick one’s hand while eating. If a monk, out of disrespect, licks his hand while eating, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if he is the first offender. The second training rule is finished.
“‘I will not lick my hand while eating,’ this is how you should train.”
